in_sanskrit.name: देवान्जलि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who offers something to the God. The word is derived from 'Deva' (God) and 'Anjali' (offering).

in_hindi.name: देवाञ्जली
in_hindi.meaning: देव के लिए अन्जलि (Dev ke liye Anjali)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who offers something to the God. The word is derived from 'Deva' (God) and 'Anjali' (offering).

in_tamil.name: தேவாஜலி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who offers something to the God. The word is derived from 'Thevan' (God) and 'Azhagiyathil' (offering).

in_telugu.name: దేశేశ్వరాజలి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who offers something to the God. The word is derived from 'Desvaru' (God) and 'Ajjalii' (offering).

in_marathi.name: Devanjali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devanjali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi (Goddess) + Anjali (Offering or Worship) + Ali (Another Form of Goddess Lakshmi)

in_bengali.name: Devanjali
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Prosperity
